integrity: The elementary finite trigonometric calculations and their assumptions are explicitly presented; numeric tests support reproduction but do not replace the analytical proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact two-dimensional consistent projection equations with equally spaced normalized rows and two distinct uniformly drawn rows; no claim for block solvers, noisy systems, repeated draws, higher dimensions, or optimal computational time.
Uniformly sharp one-step mean-square progress; the iterated conditional upper bound is not asserted to be the exact asymptotic mean-square rate.
title: Sharp parity-dependent two-sample Kaczmarz contraction on planar harmonic frames
